title: Norml Page Structures
pitch: Plan page elements and editing fields from a complete reusable page/block catalog.
problem: A template can look finished while missing required content, navigation or editor fields.
This catalog makes structure, content slots and conditional requirements explicit before building.

flow.d: Read matching page, archetype and blocks.
Record requirement levels, slots and overrides.
Implement with the project design system.
Test real content, editor and responsive behavior.

commands: What elements belong on this page?
Plan a blog single and archive

items.name: Page specifications
items.desc: 16 linked page specifications preserve ordered elements and conditional defaults.

items.name: Block contracts
items.desc: 43 blocks include slot/data shapes, implementation choices and variants.

items.name: Variant acceptance
items.desc: Stable IDs, source version, use/avoid conditions and runtime coverage.

items.name: Bio archetype
items.desc: Text-only layout/ACF field contract without client screenshots.

items: Does not contain target framework code or a visual design system.
Cannot invent missing content, evidence, assets or integration behavior.
Defaults may be overridden by an explicit recorded project decision.
